verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of performance at large scale, and none on whether item caps apply to boards or workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. The 'scaling' claims cover hosting for developer apps, not board performance or item limits. Community reports of slowness are anecdotal and give no scale figures, so they cannot establish delivery of this story.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
